verdict.rationale: Slack ships an official CLI (slack-docs-9, slack-probe-4), Bolt SDK starter templates (slack-docs-26/40), a documented Web API (slack-docs-8/32, live-verified in slack-probe-5), Events API for realtime integration (slack-docs-6/7/31), and an official MCP server (slack-docs-2/28, live-verified via slack-probe-6), giving AI-native developers multiple official, hands-on-verified SDK/tooling paths. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI spec found (slack-probe-2 shows 404s) and no independent third-party corroboration beyond first-party docs/probes.
